'''Rockong''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Rockwu]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Crowned in gold, Rockong has every Tatari's back. One strike of that majestic staff is all it takes to remind everyone who runs these parts."

Rockong is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Original Bio: "Having fufilled its destiny of martial arts master, it will next attempt to master its six senses."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Rockong doesn't just use any ordinary staff. It's a stick forged from scrap iron into the mightiest of sticks!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Rockong's staff can change size at will. Rockong is truly the chosen one among Punchimps, though no one knows how the selection was made."
